## Design Context

### Users
Researchers and readers summarizing batches of technical blog posts.

### Brand Personality
Technical, efficient, and utilitarian. The interface should help users stay focused and feel confident about processing and exporting summaries.

### Aesthetic Direction
Dark, technical, and utilitarian.

### Design Principles
- Keep batch processing status and recovery actions clear.
- Prioritize readable summaries and efficient comparison.
- Make model readiness and processing constraints explicit.
- Favor practical controls and restrained visual decoration.
